exact_response:
Mocking people for being Asian isn’t automatically harmless. Racial jokes can reinforce stereotypes, humiliate people, and make exclusion feel acceptable—even when the speaker intends humor.

Context matters: affectionate teasing among friends differs from targeting someone’s ethnicity, and laughing along doesn’t necessarily mean someone is comfortable.
